Chapter 1307: 47: The Source Of The Demonic Calamity

Chapter 1307: Chapter 47: The Source of the Demonic Calamity

…

“Alright, this heritage ends here. To be able to view up to this point means you have thoroughly comprehended this level, and have not yet become an Eternal Lord. Congratulations, there’s a high possibility you will become an Eternal Lord.”

The Lord of Heaven Light smiled and said, “If you are already an Eternal Lord, then comprehending this level will also be helpful for the path of runes in the future, and should offer some benefits in consolidating your past, present, and future timelines.”

Lin Yuan quietly listened.

This heritage left by the Lord of Heaven Light has never been fully comprehended, even by many Eternal Lords. As for those beings below the Eternal Lord? To this day, none have appeared.

Even Lin Yuan took more than ten thousand years to fully comprehend it, by merging numerous heritages from the Fang Yuan World, leveraging Against-Heaven’s Understanding, and operating the rules of several dimension space Great Daos.

What do other beings use to comprehend it?

“Actually, I envy you very much.”

The Lord of Heaven Light’s face showed a smile. At this moment, He was in the form of a Demon God, and the smile appeared somewhat ferocious, “Breaking through to an Eternal Lord, there is still a direction to strive for. The time cycle is not absolute. The heritage I established can mildly break the constraints of the time cycle. Some special heritages or methods in infinite dimensional space can have similar effects.”

“Although fully comprehending and mastering it is very difficult, at least there is hope, and one can approach in this direction. Even if one ultimately doesn’t reach it, it still provides some help for oneself.”

The Lord of Heaven Light’s expression was complicated, “But for me to take that step, it’s no longer a matter of hope or not hope. Life forms of time wanting to transform to the perfect actually set their fate at the beginning of their path of cultivation. It either can or cannot; no matter how much effort is put in, it’s still cannot.”

The Lord of Heaven Light slightly shook His head: “And before making that leap, no life form of time can know for certain whether they can or cannot. The future timeline fundamentally cannot touch the Fourteenth Rank level.”

Lin Yuan listened attentively to the Lord of Heaven Light’s discourse.

Especially the last few sentences, which mentioned a bit of information about the transformation of time life forms to Perfect Time Beings.

“It either can or cannot?”

“Cannot, no matter how much effort is put in, it’s still cannot?”

Lin Yuan frowned slightly, able to sense the helplessness in the Lord of Heaven Light as He spoke these words.

It carried a sense of being shrouded by destiny, a feeling of predestination.

Yet, playing with destiny is exactly what time life forms do, observing countless timelines, choosing the future they want, but ultimately, they are still bound by destiny.

“So, stepping into the Fourteenth Rank has no threshold, and any Thirteenth Rank peak can attempt it, but whether they succeed or not is another matter?”

From the few words of the Lord of Heaven Light, Lin Yuan drew some conclusions.

This is completely different from breaking through from the Twelfth Rank to the Thirteenth Rank.

The biggest threshold for breaking through from the Twelfth Rank to the Thirteenth Rank is the time cycle.

Yet the time cycle is not without countermeasures. Putting aside the heritage left by the Lord of Heaven Light, the very path of heritage evolution and anchoring the ‘anchor’ beyond can aid in breaking through the time cycle.

But from the Thirteenth Rank to the Fourteenth Rank? It was determined from the very beginning of the cultivation path? No turning back, no changing.

And according to the information Lin Yuan currently knows, Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Beings are exceedingly rare.

More accurately, it’s not that their numbers are rare, but whether they even exist at all is another question.

At least through many traversals, Lin Yuan has come in contact or heard a bit about some time life forms.

And through each time life form, he also learned about more time life forms, but a Perfect Time Being?

It is only known that at this level of life, they wander through past, present, and future, able to designate the future they want. If they are dissatisfied with the future, they can forcibly change it by going to the past, creating the future they desire.

But up to now, whether there has been any definite Perfect Time Being, Lin Yuan has never heard of.

Even the six ancestors of the first source world have not heard of it.

The only thing Lin Yuan can be certain of related to the Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Beings is the projection of the Myriad Realms Gate in the depths of his mind.

The Myriad Realms Gate jumps out of the timeline and cannot be observed by time life forms. Just this characteristic matches a Perfect Time Being.

…

“It’s over.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Lord of Heaven Light’s figure gradually disappearing below the firmament.

He was somewhat emotional.

Completely comprehending such a heritage unexpectedly revealed the truth of the demon scourge, an unexpected gain indeed.

Test space.

The avatar left by Lin Yuan opened its eyes.

The azure book floating in front of him slowly descended, and the light emanating from within completely dimmed.

“You?”

The golden figure’s eyes widened, “You thoroughly comprehended this heritage?”

The azure book is one of the original heritages created by the Lord of Heaven Light. After any life fully comprehends it, the book itself will immerse for a period, at which point the light disappears.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

After comprehending this heritage, Lin Yuan’s understanding of runes had reached an unbelievable level. Every thought in his mind was of runes, able even to briefly bind timelines for future viewing.

With Lin Yuan’s current level of runic attainment, he possessed some characteristics of time life forms observing future timelines.

“It’s incomparable to true time life forms, but the future timelines he sees are much clearer than those observed with the Sky Void Tripod.”

One by one, timelines gradually unfolded before Lin Yuan’s eyes, observing various future scenarios.

“Pervert.”

The golden figure looked at Lin Yuan, momentarily unsure how to comment.

Even though he saw the scene of Lin Yuan and the Demon God in direct conflict, the heritage left by the azure book was comprehended by Lin Yuan, which even many Eternal Lords could not understand.

“Why didn’t the great Master of Wushan…?”

The golden figure appeared slightly puzzled. Given Lin Yuan’s current performance, the great Master of Wushan, having foreseen future timelines, how could He not leave any arrangements?

…

Beyond the source world.

In a vast space-time with infinite light.

Thirteen towering figures stood silently, on the one hand resisting the all-encompassing light, while on the other trying to observe many future timelines as much as possible.

“Eternal Lord, Eternal Lord, all are Eternal Lords.”

Master of Wushan’s eyes were filled with shock, discovering through observing more timelines that the one called ‘Galaxy’ could all become an Eternal Lord.

“This ‘Galaxy’ bears some karma with me and even obtained the heritage I left in the test space?”

Master of Wushan was somewhat astonished. He had never seen such a certain future.

“Sooner in a few millennia, later in tens of thousands of years, this ‘Galaxy’ can become an Eternal Lord, and shortly thereafter, will become a Time Lord, closing and consolidating its own timeline.”

Master of Black Space spoke, his gaze equally shaken.

Since recently noticing Lin Yuan’s uniqueness, the thirteen Eternal Lords undertook different responsibilities.

Some Eternal Lords tried to observe more timelines to see if the ‘Galaxy’ in other timelines could become an Eternal Lord.

Other Eternal Lords delved into certain timelines to judge to what extent this ‘Galaxy’ could ultimately grow.

The results shocked all the Eternal Lords.

Firstly, as of now, none of the many timelines observed showed a future where Lin Yuan had not become an Eternal Lord.

Not to mention not becoming an Eternal Lord, there wasn’t even a future where he became an Eternal Lord in a hundred thousand years.

Secondly, delving into particular timelines, Lin Yuan’s growth was incredibly swift, achieving becoming a Time Lord in a short time.

Time Lord?

This source world has existed for countless ages, with only one Time Lord known, the Lord of Heaven Light.

And strictly speaking, the Lord of Heaven Light is not a native life of this source world.

This is known by all the Eternal Lords.

In other words, from the birth of this world until now, it hasn’t birthed a single Time Lord.

And this ‘Galaxy’, after becoming an Eternal Lord, will in a short time walk a path that none of the Eternal Lords has yet completed?
